EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_DISPLAY_TIME.title: Emote Display Time
EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_DISPLAY_TIME.hover.desc:
How long every emote stays on screen.
Only affects your own screen.
EMOTEPLUS-MAP_EMOTE_DISPLAY_TIME.title: Map Emote Display Time
EMOTEPLUS-MAP_EMOTE_DISPLAY_TIME.hover.d: How long emotes sent while the map is open stay on screen. Only affects your own screen.
EMOTEPLUS-REPEAT_EMOTE_TIME.title: Repeat Emote Window
EMOTEPLUS-REPEAT_EMOTE_TIME.hover.desc:
Press the emote key and release it right away without moving the mouse to send your previous emote again.
To cancel instead, wait longer than this time, then release the key at the center of the wheel to send nothing.
EMOTEPLUS-ENABLE_IN_SINGLEPLAYER.title: Use Emotes in Singleplayer
EMOTEPLUS-ENABLE_IN_SINGLEPLAYER.hover.d: Lets you use the emote wheel in singleplayer too.
EMOTEPLUS-REVERSE_SCROLL_PAGING.title: Reverse Scroll Paging Direction
EMOTEPLUS-REVERSE_SCROLL_PAGING.hover.de: While the emote wheel is open, scrolling down goes to the next page and scrolling up goes to the previous page. Turn this on to reverse it.
EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_VISIBILITY.title: Emotes Shown on the Wheel
EMOTEPLUS-EMOTE_VISIBILITY_HINT.title:
Click an emote to toggle whether it shows on your own wheel (gaps are closed up). If all are hidden, all are shown.
This doesn't affect the emotes other players use.
EMOTEPLUS-WHEEL_ORDER_IMAGE.title: Order on the Wheel
EMOTEPLUS-WHEEL_ORDER_IMAGE.hover.desc:
Each row of the grid below corresponds to one page of the wheel.
The order in the grid is placed clockwise from the right on that page.
If you enable emotes in singleplayer, you can try them for real with the V key.
EMOTEPLUS-SWAP_MODE.title: Swap Mode
EMOTEPLUS-SWAP_MODE.hover.desc:
You can drag emotes to swap their order.
While this mode is on, clicking two emotes in turn swaps them.
EMOTEPLUS-DEFAULT_ORDER.title: Recommended Order
EMOTEPLUS-DEFAULT_ORDER.hover.desc: Rearranges all emotes into the creator's recommended grouping.
EMOTEPLUS-VANILLA_ORDER.title: Vanilla Order
EMOTEPLUS-VANILLA_ORDER.hover.desc:
Puts the original game's 8 emotes at the front in their proper order.
The order of the other emotes isn't affected.
EMOTEPLUS-PACK_HIDDEN_EMOTES.title: Hidden to End
EMOTEPLUS-PACK_HIDDEN_EMOTES.hover.desc:
Moves hidden emotes to the end.
Emotes shown on the wheel are packed toward the front, so each row of the grid matches one wheel page.
EMOTEPLUS-SHOW_ALL_EMOTES.title: Show All
EMOTEPLUS-SHOW_ALL_EMOTES.hover.desc: Shows every emote on the wheel.
EMOTEPLUS-HIDE_ALL_EMOTES.title: Hide All
EMOTEPLUS-HIDE_ALL_EMOTES.hover.desc:
Hides every emote.
If you open the wheel with everything hidden, it's treated as if all emotes were shown.
